data.gender_notes: Clémence is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'clemens' meaning merciful, kind, and gentle. This name was often given to girls in the Middle Ages in honor of the Christian saints Clemens and Clemence. The name has strong spiritual undertones and is often associated with compassion and forgiveness. The name Clémence carries the meaning “Merciful and gentle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Clémence usually hope their child will grow to embody merciful and gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Girls named Clémence were expected to embody these qualities and set an example for others in their communities.
